name: hcloud-go-lossless-forward-compatible-schema-f499
instr:
hcloud-go cannot preserve API fields unknown to the installed client while round-tripping recognized fields normally. Preserve unknown JSON at its original object boundary through decoding, public conversion, copying, request conversion, and HTTP resource operations.

Each participating object, including Network, Certificate, LoadBalancerType, LoadBalancerAlgorithm, LoadBalancerCreateOptsService, LoadBalancerCreateOptsServiceHTTP, and LoadBalancerCreateOptsServiceHealthCheck, must own its unknown top-level JSON members without moving them across nesting boundaries. UnknownFields.Clone and all public-to-schema and schema-to-public conversions must preserve raw values while isolating maps and bytes, including nil versus empty collections.

Each UnknownJSONFields method must expose only its receiver's retained members. Each SetUnknownJSONFields method must independently own supplied values. Declared JSON members take precedence over colliding unknown names and are emitted once. Malformed retained JSON must cause a deterministic marshaling error. When retention is unused, preserve existing addressing, timestamps, nullable certificate status, references, ordering, response metadata, not-found behavior, and declared-field-only JSON.

A network retrieved through NewClient must retain its public extension and addressing through reverse conversion. Identically named extensions on load-balancer parents, algorithms, services, HTTP options, and health checks must remain object-local. Upl
